'''2001 Denver DPC invitational''' was a Star Wars CCG invitational held in Tacticon, Denver, Colorado on 2 September 2001. [[Josh Bader]] won it. It is known from William Diniega's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2943">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-08-denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-mand2943/ denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-man], DeckTech (William "FredDurst100" Diniega, 8 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-08-denver-dpc-aka-hayes-u-da-mand2943/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Denver DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 2 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Tacticon, Denver, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Bader]]
